readonly_unsupported: Cannot apply read-only mode on this launch path. Choose a compatible terminal launcher without conflicting permission options.
timeout: The request timed out. The computer may be busy or the network unstable. Check whether it went through, then try again later.
unreachable: The connection to this computer dropped. Reconnect it, check whether your last action went through, then try again.
failed: The request could not be completed. Open details for the diagnostic.
input_draft: There is a draft in the terminal. Resolve it before sending.
dialog_open: The terminal is waiting for a choice. Resolve it there first.
prompt_changed: The terminal prompt has changed. Refresh before answering.
attach_busy: This session is busy in another client. Wait until it is available.
terminal_not_ready: The computer’s terminal wasn’t ready to start the agent. Nothing was sent; try again.
node_outdated: The computer’s Persona service is too old for this operation. Update it first.
in_doubt: Delivery cannot be confirmed. Check the result before sending again.
offline: This computer is offline. Make sure it’s on and connected to the internet and that Persona Link is running, then try again.
nothing_queued: Nothing is queued for the agent any more.
send_now_unsupported: This agent can’t send queued messages now. They go to it in order.
send_now_unrecognized: Persona doesn’t recognize this Claude Code’s send-now hint, so it pressed nothing. The queued messages still go in order; to send them now, use send-now in the terminal.
not_a_repository: This folder isn’t in a Git repository.
not_our_worktree: This folder isn’t a worktree Persona made.
worktree_in_use: An agent still runs in this worktree. Close it first.
worktree_unmerged: The branch has commits that aren’t on the main branch.
no_directory: Persona doesn’t know this pane’s folder.
detached_head: HEAD is detached. Switch to a branch first.
no_upstream: This branch has no upstream branch. Set one on the computer first.
uncommitted_changes: The working tree has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them on the computer, then pull.
not_fast_forward: The branch and its upstream have both moved on, so it can’t fast-forward. Merge or rebase it on the computer.
push_rejected: The remote has newer commits. Pull first, then push. Nothing was forced.
peer_unsupported: This Claude session doesn’t offer a channel Persona can use for messages (an older Claude Code, or cross-session messages are turned off there). Continue it on the computer.
peer_unreachable: Couldn’t reach this Claude session’s message channel (it may have just restarted or quit). Try again shortly, or continue it on the computer.
peer_too_long: The message is too long for the message channel. Split it into shorter messages.
peer_unconfirmed: The message was handed to this Claude session, but it hasn’t taken it yet: it may be waiting for approval on the computer, or it was dropped as a repeat. Check on the computer before sending it again.
peer_command: The message channel only delivers plain messages and doesn’t run slash commands. Type the command on the computer.
modes_on_computer: This Claude session runs in Claude on the computer (its desktop app or another terminal). Change its mode, effort or model there.
modes_not_running: This agent isn’t running. Send it a message to resume it, then change this.
shell_waiting: The new terminal tab stopped on a question before the agent could start. Nothing ran; the tab stays open for a few minutes so it can be answered.
start_line_rejected: The new terminal tab didn't take the start command, twice. Nothing ran; check what that shell does when it starts, then try again.
directory_untypable: This directory’s name contains a control character, such as a tab or a line break, so the agent can’t be started in it from here. Rename the directory or choose another one.
